facts.text: Jolene signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake.

evidence.quote: I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake.

facts.text: Jolene and Deborah both mention that meditation has become part of their routine and helps them with their health and studies.

evidence.quote: It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!
It's become part of my routine now.
It helps me stay balanced during my studies.

facts.text: Deborah expresses happiness that Jolene finds meditation helpful and asks about the progress of her project.

evidence.quote: Glad to hear it, Jolene. How's the project going?
